iot-dws-integration.title: IoT-DWS Integration System
iot-dws-integration.summary: Designed and deployed an integration system between IoT devices and DWS (Dimensioning Weighing Scanning) machines across 16 sortations.

context.content: Took over and rapidly mastered an IoT-DWS system after the previous responsible team member left the project. Needed to quickly understand the current architecture and continue developing the integration solution.

problem.content: Needed integration between IoT devices (sensors, cameras) and DWS machines — a complex physical system with multiple different protocols (HMI, FTP, HTTP).

solution.content: Designed an HTTP-based integration engine with HMAC security, RocketMQ messaging, and protocol adapters for HMI/FTP/HTTP.

challenges.content: Multiple different protocols, security requirements (HMAC signature), real-time data processing, production reliability.

result.content: Solution deployed across 16 sortations, stable in production, supporting 3 protocols (HMI, FTP, HTTP).

awb-detection.summary: Applied Computer Vision and Machine Learning to automatically detect and OCR shipping labels from camera images on sortation lines.

context.content: Sortation machines capture images of packages as they move on conveyor belts. Need to automatically read AWB (Air Waybill) from images for tracking and sorting.

problem.content: White label on white package — traditional CV methods are not robust enough. Needed ML-based detection.

result.content: Model fine-tuned for AWB detection, processing 70,000 images/month. Presented at Tech Talk workshop.
